headline: They Advise the Minister. No Recommendation Is in the Budget. "Sparks Are Flying a Little"
summary: Poland's Fiscal Council advises the finance minister on budget matters. If the Council recommends something, the minister applies it, and if not, he must explain why he did not.
why: Fiscal councils are independent bodies that assess government budgets and debt rules, so their recommendations shape fiscal credibility and government bond market sentiment.
